meta.prices: poe.ninja exchange, league Forbidden Rites, 2026-10-18 (divine; 1 div = 710.6 ex = 10.6 chaos). Tiers: cheap < 0.05 div, mid < 2, high < 20, very high >= 20. Low-volume items (lich omens, Ulaman/Amanamu Gaze, Starlit Ores) are noisy.
meta.lichSource: Local RePoE cache %APPDATA%/PoE 2 Price Checker/Cache/repoe-mods.json (repoe-fork poe2 mods.min.json), domain 'desecrated', spawn tag ulaman_mod / amanamu_mod / kurgal_mod; class membership = first-match spawn_weights evaluated against the tags of every released base of the class (repoe-base-items.json). Counts: Ulaman 26P/51S, Amanamu 24P/39S, Kurgal 21P/37S = 198, all level 65; disabled (all weights 0): Amanamu '(8-15)% of Leech is Instant'; also Ulaman 'reduced Movement Speed Penalty from using Skills while moving' (no spawn tags at all). Lists hold distinct texts (one text can be several mods with different tiers per class). Before computing 'guaranteed if <= 3 options', drop mods whose group is already on the item (lichModIndex.group).
meta.lichModsNote: lichMods = classes where the omen is accepted (weapons + amulet/ring/belt; quiver M). Sceptre has no lich mods. lichModsNoOmen = helmet/gloves/boots/body/shield/buckler/focus lich mods (focus also has prefixes): they appear only in an un-omened reveal, mixed with base mods; "[only: ...]" marks mods limited to some attribute bases.

items.name: Omen of the Sovereign
items.effect: Next Weapon or Jewellery Desecration guarantees a random Ulaman modifier (reveal options limited to Ulaman's pool for the item class and side)

classes: weapons (bow, crossbow, wand, staff, quarterstaff, spear, maces, talisman, claw, dagger, flail, swords, axes)

omens: Omen of Abyssal Echoes (one reroll of the 3 options)
Omen of Light + Orb of Annulment (remove it and retry)
items.notes: Text: 'While this item is active in your inventory your next Weapon or Jewellery Desecration attempt will guarantee a random Ulaman modifier'. GGG (Timothy_GGG, forum thread 3834266): 'The Lich specific omens are only compatible with weapons and jewelry' - Rib on a Focus/armour is rejected ('Omen is incompatible with this Desecrating item'). Belts work (Collarbone). Lich mods are all level 65 -> needs ilvl >= 65 and a Preserved/Ancient bone; Gnawed (ilvl <= 64) is rejected. With the omen the 3 reveal options come from this lich's pool for the item class and side (community recipes: Sovereign + Sinistral on a crossbow 'always reveals' +1 Ballista; M). Pools: lichMods. Quivers take a Jawbone; whether they count as 'Weapon' for the omen is unconfirmed (M).

items.name: Liquid Verisium
items.effect: Immediately start a Runic Remnant Encounter with a random Runic Inscription (used on a Runic Remnant in a map)

items.name: Verisium
items.effect: Spent at the Verisium Anvil to Runeforge equipment: armour base -> 'Runeforged <base>' with Runic Ward (e.g. Vaal Cuirass x130: Armour 298 kept + 70 Runic Ward). Cost by base: 20-230 for body armours, up to ~490 for level-80 shields/foci. Bases >= level 55 lose part of the base defence (RePoE: Tasalian Focus ES 91->36, Desert Buckler EV 192->87, Blacksteel Crest Shield AR 145->52; body armours of level <= 51 unchanged). Also paid in Unique Runeforging together with a Crest.
items.notes: Patch 0.5.0: 'Verisium Runeforging ... allows you to add Runic Ward to your armours by spending verisium'; 'Armours lower than level 55 gain Runic Ward with no downside. Armours above this level trade some of their regular base defences for Runic Ward.' The item becomes base 'Runeforged <base>' (tag runeforged); RePoE has no mods spawning on the runeforged tag -> modifier pool unchanged. Mods/rarity are kept (the base is transformed, not rerolled) - not stated verbatim, M.

items.name: Exceptional Verisium
items.effect: Verisium Anvil currency for special bases: Sacrificial Regalia -> Runeforged Sacrificial Regalia (x20; 4 variants with a different defence pair + extra implicit: life / all res / chaos damage per corrupted item); Grasping Mail -> Runeforged (x5) -> Runemastered (x10) -> Runefather's Grasping Mail (x20), defence type changes (str/dex/int variants). Also part of some Unique Runeforging recipes (e.g. Brutus' Lead Sprinkler x3).
items.notes: Implicits/defences change -> item value changes; mods presumably kept (M).

items.name: Greater Chaos Orb
items.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new random modifier. Minimum Modifier Level: 35 (for the added modifier)
omens: Omen of Whittling (removes the lowest-level mod)
Omen of Sinistral / Dextral Erasure (removes only a prefix / suffix)

items.name: Perfect Chaos Orb
items.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new random modifier. Minimum Modifier Level: 50 (for the added modifier)
items.notes: Expensive in Forbidden Rites (~7.7 div): Whittling/Erasure + Perfect Chaos costs ~20-28 div per step.

items.name: Greater Regal Orb
items.effect: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 modifier; current modifiers are retained. Minimum Modifier Level: 35
omens: Omen of Sinistral / Dextral Coronation (adds only a prefix / suffix)

items.name: Perfect Regal Orb
items.effect: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 modifier; current modifiers are retained. Minimum Modifier Level: 50
items.notes: Cheap (~0.05 div): on ilvl 75+ bases it is almost always better than a plain Regal.

items.name: Omen of Whittling
items.effect: Next Chaos Orb will remove the lowest level modifier
omens: works with Greater/Perfect Chaos (same Chaos Orb family; M/H)
with Sinistral/Dextral Erasure -> lowest-level mod on that side (M)

items.name: Omen of Sinistral Erasure
items.effect: Next Chaos Orb will remove only prefix modifiers
items.notes: The text does not lock the side of the added modifier; when the other side is full it can only land on the freed side (M).

items.name: Omen of Dextral Erasure
items.effect: Next Chaos Orb will remove only suffix modifiers
items.notes: Same as Sinistral, suffix side.

items.name: Omen of Sinistral Coronation
items.effect: Next Regal Orb will add only prefix modifiers (Dextral: only suffix)

items.name: Altered Collarbone
items.effect: Desecrates a Rare Amulet, Ring or Belt with a chance for 'otherworldly' modifiers (Breach-themed desecrated pool: 4 amulet, 16 ring, 16 belt mods - see alteredCollarbonePool)
items.notes: Otherworldly mods are level 1 in RePoE (tag breach_desecration) -> Whittling treats them as lowest-level. Chance vs the normal pool is not published (L).

items.name: Omen of Amelioration
items.effect: Prevents 75% of Experience loss when you die

items.name: Omen of Answered Prayers
items.effect: Next Shrine you click grants an additional Effect

items.name: Ancient Infuser
items.effect: Modifies a Tablet unpredictably and Corrupts it

items.name: Core Destabiliser
items.effect: Modifies a Soul Core unpredictably, with a chance to destroy it
items.notes: Changes the socketable, not the item.

items.name: Vaal Siphoner
items.effect: Adds a kill threshold to a Corrupted Rare Jewellery item; when it is met, siphons (removes) a random modifier and improves the numeric values of the other modifiers
items.notes: Post-corruption gamble on jewellery: -1 random mod, + values of the rest. Worth it only when one mod is junk or values are low.

items.name: Orb of Extraction
items.effect: Destroys an Equipment item, returning any non Socket-Bound Augments socketed in it
items.notes: Advise only when the socketed augments are worth more than the item + ~2.35 div (Thesis cores, Emergent runes, Gazes).

items.name: Artificer's Shard

items.name: Crystallised Corruption

items.name: Architect's Orb

runesData.format: Object keyed by Metadata path (e.g. 'Metadata/Items/SoulCores/RuneDexterityPerfect'; name = base_items[key].name). Value: {type_id: Rune|SoulCore|Idol|AbyssalEye|CongealedMist, type_name, required_level (may be absent), limit ('1', '1 [Ancient|Ancient Augment]', "1 [AldursLegacy|Aldur's Legacy]" or absent), categories: {<slot label>: {target: [item classes] | 'Armour' | 'All Equipment' | '[MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon]' | 'Wand or Staff', stat_text: [..] (may be absent), stats: [{id, local}], bonded_stat_text: [..], bonded_stats: [..]}}}. Slot labels: All, Martial Weapon, Wand or Staff, Sceptre, Caster Weapon, Martial Or Caster Weapon, Armour, Body Armour, Helmet, Gloves, Boots, Shield, Buckler, Shield or Buckler, Focus, Wand, Staff, Bow, Crossbow, Spear, Quarterstaff, One/Two Hand Mace, Talisman and combos. Text uses the [Key|Shown] markup of mods.json.
runesData.notes: 313 entries (221 Rune, 52 SoulCore, 35 Idol, 4 AbyssalEye, 1 CongealedMist); file Last-Modified 2026-09-11 (0.5.5b). Same host the app already uses for mods.min.json / base_items.min.json (src/main/craft.js REPOE). 'bonded_*' = Bonded effects that apply only with the Shaman notable Wisdom of the Maji - ignore for normal pricing (some runes, e.g. Perfect Adept/Robust/Resolve on weapons, have ONLY bonded text there). One augment grants the line of the slot it is socketed in (Perfect Iron Rune: martial 20% inc Physical Damage, wand/staff 35% Spell Damage, armour 20% inc Armour/Evasion/ES). 'Armour' label covers all armour incl. shields/foci (M). Prices: poe.ninja Forbidden Rites 2026-10-18; Idols and Aldur's Legacy runes have no exchange price.
